description: The C_DRV_1D block controls and supervises a single unidirectional motor or drive in a cement plant.

inputs.name: ERM
inputs.description: Contactor feedback from the motor starter

inputs.name: ESB
inputs.description: Electrical availability signal from the MCC or motor supply

inputs.name: EBM
inputs.description: Overload/bimetal healthy signal from the motor protection

inputs.name: EVO
inputs.description: Local/remote selector switch from the field

inputs.name: EEVG
inputs.description: Start interlock, typically from another process object such as a damper position

inputs.name: IntStart
inputs.description: Structured start interlock, typically connected from another block's structure output

inputs.name: EBVG
inputs.description: Operating interlock, typically from the downstream drive running signal

inputs.name: IntOper
inputs.description: Structured operating interlock, commonly connected from another drive's RunSig

inputs.name: ESVG
inputs.description: General protection interlock, typically driven from an annunciation block output

inputs.name: ESVA
inputs.description: Protection interlock active only in automatic/single-start mode

inputs.name: ESPO
inputs.description: Sporadic ON/OFF control signal for automatic operation

inputs.name: SW_SPEED
inputs.description: Pulse input for software speed monitor

inputs.name: SM_EVS_I
inputs.description: Determines when running feedback is generated with the speed monitor

inputs.name: L_STA_WA
inputs.description: Enables startup warning in local mode

inputs.name: NSTP_L_A
inputs.description: Allows switching from local to automatic without stopping

inputs.name: LST_ACT
inputs.description: Makes local stop active in automatic mode

inputs.name: ELOC
inputs.description: Local mode release, normally connected from the group's local-mode output

inputs.name: EEIZ
inputs.description: Single-start mode release, normally connected from the group's single-start output

inputs.name: EMFR
inputs.description: Message enable signal, typically from control-voltage OK

inputs.name: EMZS
inputs.description: Prevents faults from contributing to group summarizing indication

inputs.name: GFSO
inputs.description: Removes drive from group fault/status processing

inputs.name: EBFE
inputs.description: Automatic start command, typically from group GBE or route WBE

inputs.name: EBFA
inputs.description: Automatic stop command, typically from group GDE or route WDE

inputs.name: QSTP
inputs.description: Quick-stop command from the controlling group

inputs.name: DSIG_BQ
inputs.description: OR of driver block bad-quality outputs

inputs.name: DSIG_SIM
inputs.description: OR of driver block simulation outputs

inputs.name: MV_PERC
inputs.description: Percentage motor current from C_MEASUR or C_SIMOS

inputs.name: PV
inputs.description: Process value for display, typically from C_MEASUR or C_ANA_SEL

inputs.name: PV_Stat
inputs.description: Unit and status associated with PV

inputs.name: SP_EX
inputs.description: External setpoint from another control block

inputs.name: PV_IN
inputs.description: Actual process value for the setpoint function

outputs.name: EVS
outputs.description: Running signal used as feedback to the group/route and as an interlock

outputs.name: RunSig
outputs.description: Structured running signal for connection to other blocks' structured interlocks

outputs.name: HORN
outputs.description: Startup warning output for horn or lamp

outputs.name: EVSP
outputs.description: Running signal for sporadic drives; typically used as group feedback

outputs.name: SIM_ON
outputs.description: Simulation active output for driver blocks

outputs.name: SP_O
outputs.description: Validated setpoint output to a VSD or driver block
